steps.title: Start with 3 panels
steps.instruction: Join 3 panels (A, B, C), as the animation shows. Page 4 of the IKEA manual shows this step.

faq.answer: This guide doesn’t show fittings for the PERJOHAN chair. Page 4 of the paper manual shows which ones to use and how many.
The blue parts: A (panel, about 79 cm), B (panel, about 67 cm), C (panel, about 67 cm). Watch where they go in the animation.
Sizes are approximate: this model has no real measurements, so it is shown about 82 cm tall.
